decisions.cost_rule: A miss costs more than a false action: a real defect ranked low is buried, while a false positive ranked high only costs a maintainer's glance. Fewer than about 30 labelled cases per label means the skill's provisional 0.3 for a costlier miss (building-eval-data), tuned on nothing.
assumptions: The owner agreed triage-only minimums of 0.8 precision and 0.9 recall on 2026-11-08 from exploratory data, not explicit costs, and separately confirmed misses cost more (R-063 in docs/research-ledger.md). The exploratory F1 run with minimums 0.01 used E2 v1_choice-guide labels and v2_noul scores, not this question/state or its F-beta beta 2 policy; it is not citable experiment evidence. This entry's threshold was not tuned on that run and remains 0.3 provisional.
Launch uses P(real_defect) only to order findings, so nothing reads the threshold: gating is false, the finding is never closed, hidden or filtered by it.

Human labels exist for E2's v1_choice question, but no label set exists for this question version. The label set is none, the threshold is untuned, and the minimums were owner-set (R-063); status stays provisional until a preregistered D1-R tuning run reports ready.

Replacing this entry needs at least 30 human or agent_reviewed labels per label (real_defect and false_positive) under the frozen current-question guide and blind two-labeller protocol with adjudication, stratified by path role and rule and split dev/test by repository, then a preregistered tuning run on saved scores with `--beta 2`. Legacy v1_choice-guide labels do not count toward that floor. All 52 jev-triage-labels-v1 cases and the E2 v2_noul score files are examined data: X1 and D1-R must disclose them, may use them only for development, and must draw confirmatory test data from unexamined cases. The backlog item is B-2 in docs/jev-adapter-audit.md.

This entry has no pinned version key: it is bound to the question's current version key when loaded. A file at .scout/decisions/thresholds.json pins one; a key that no longer matches the current version marks the entry stale.
